import zipfile, tempfile, subprocess, os, random
z=zipfile.ZipFile('suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasmnext_seed_corpus.zip')
files=[n for n in z.namelist() if n.startswith('corpus/')]
random.seed(0)
for name in random.sample(files, 20):
    fd, path=tempfile.mkstemp(dir='/tmp', suffix='.bin')
    os.write(fd, z.read(name)); os.close(fd)
    res=subprocess.run(['./build/fuzz_disasm', path], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if res.returncode!=0:
        print('crash?', name, res.returncode, res.stderr[:200])
        break
else:
    print('no crash in sample')
